title: Qonclave archive record
description: A finalized event committed to long-term storage. COMMUNICATION.md §7. Written via S3-compatible PutObject so a tenant can point at MinIO, AWS S3, or their own vetted backend. Archive nodes are per-tenant and never shared (SECURITY.md §2).

event_data.description: The originating event, as accepted by the hub.

decision.description: What the hub's Policy concluded and did about it.

audit.description: Provenance for compliance. Records which nodes touched this event and where inference actually ran — placement means that is not knowable from the topology alone.

grant_id.description: Set when the event arrived via a capability grant rather than from a directly commissioned device.

key_id.description: Encryption key this record is sealed under. Cryptographic erasure (SECURITY.md §4) destroys the key rather than the objects, so every record sharing a key_id becomes unreadable at once.
